newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony climbs to new high on weak yen, earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Sony climbs to new high on weak yen, earnings hopes.

text.p: Sony Corp climbed to a new record high in early Monday morning trade helped by a weakening of the yen against the dollar as well as speculation of robust earnings for the first quarter, brokers said.
As of 0033 GMT, the shares were up 300 yen at 11,100 yen, a fresh all-time high.
"The firm's first-quarter earnings are due out soon and investors are buying ahead of it," a trader at a medium-sized brokerage said.
The earnings are due to be announced on July 31.
UBS Securities Ltd said in a recent report that Sony's group net profits for the first quarter of 1997/98 are expected to rise by 35 percent.
